articles.summary: Encouraging new employees to jump right in to their work sounds productive, but skipping the onboarding phase can ultimately slow the entire office down.
articles.title: Onboarding debt: The productivity tax nobody puts in the budget

articles.title: When being seen matters more than doing the work
